$label: Ember · warm dark, surfaces from one tone
$description: A brand authored from almost nothing: `$ramp` derives the whole surface ladder (ground→rail) from a single warm base tone in OKLCH, the signal ramp is inherited from `dark`, and only the accent + ink/muted are set. On-colours are auto-derived. Build with `npm run build:theme` → dist/themes/ember.css.
